hints.title: Daily Aggregation Before Moving Window
hints.text: Multiple customer transactions occur on the same day. First aggregate daily revenue amounts before calculating 7-day rolling metrics.

hints.title: 7-Day Rolling Window Frame
hints.text: Use sum(amount) over (order by visited_on rows between 6 preceding and current row) on daily totals.

hints.title: Warmup Period Filter Blueprint
hints.text: Filter results where row_number() over (order by visited_on) >= 7 to exclude the initial 6 warmup days.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```mysql
WITH Daily AS (
    SELECT visited_on, SUM(amount) AS daily_amount
    FROM Customer
    GROUP BY visited_on
),
Rolling AS (
    SELECT visited_on,
           SUM(daily_amount) OVER (ORDER BY visited_on ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS amount,
           ROUND(AVG(daily_amount) OVER (ORDER BY visited_on ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 2) AS average_amount,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY visited_on) AS rn
    FROM Daily
)
SELECT visited_on, amount, average_amount
FROM Rolling
WHERE rn >= 7
ORDER BY visited_on;
```

variables: D: number of distinct days in Customer records
complexity.notes: Daily aggregation followed by rolling 7-day window function operates in linear-logarithmic time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Applying rolling windows directly on raw records averages individual transactions rather than daily totals.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Daily CTE intermediate table collapses duplicate transactions for clean sliding window math.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Pre-aggregation to daily level followed by 6 preceding window frame and warmup filter.
